scope: In-app Home 'Your numbers' card row anatomy enhancement (Plan details inside calling number rows)

row_anatomy.desktop: Flex flex-col gap-2 py-3.5 border-b border-[var(--c-border)] last:border-b-0. Header row: Left phone number (mono text-base font-semibold) + Tier Badge (civr-pill) + Extra/Main indicator; Right status (civr-pill-ok/warn) + price/mo + Chevron. Body row: Compact usage bar (minutes used/included) + renewal date/auto-renew status + inline 'Includes' feature chips + 'Upgrade' link.
row_anatomy.mobile_390px: Vertical stacked layout (max-w-[390px] w-full overflow-hidden). Row 1: Phone + Status + Chevron (min-h-[44px] tap target). Row 2: Plan tier badge + price/mo + Main/Extra badge. Row 3: Usage progress bar (minutes used/total). Row 4: Included features wrap + Upgrade button (min 44px touch target).

extras_grouping_hierarchy.main_number: Primary row container with left accent border (border-l-2 border-[#818cf8]). Shows plan tier (e.g., Pro - $29/mo) and shared minute pool.
extras_grouping_hierarchy.extra_number: Indented child row (ml-4 pl-3 border-l border-[var(--c-border)]/60 bg-[var(--c-muted)]/5 rounded-r-lg) labeled with badge 'Extra line · Included in Pro plan'.

tab_service_labeling.calling: Displays Plan Tiers (Basic/Starter/Pro/Business) & shared usage pools.
tab_service_labeling.mobile_and_texting: Displays as 'Standalone Service' (e.g. 'Hosted SMS Service' / 'Mobile Line Service') instead of plan tier to prevent plan confusion.

exact_tailwind_classes.row_wrapper: group relative flex flex-col gap-2.5 p-3.5 rounded-xl transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--c-muted)]/10 min-h-[44px]
exact_tailwind_classes.phone_display: font-mono text-base md:text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight text-[var(--c-text)] truncate
exact_tailwind_classes.tier_badge: civr-pill civr-pill-on text-xs px-2 py-0.5 font-medium rounded-md bg-[#818cf8]/15 text-[#818cf8] dark:text-[#a5b4fc]
exact_tailwind_classes.extra_badge: text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[var(--c-muted)]/20 text-[var(--c-text)]/70 font-mono
exact_tailwind_classes.minutes_bar_container: w-full flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-[var(--c-text)]/70
exact_tailwind_classes.includes_features: flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--c-text)]/80
exact_tailwind_classes.feature_chip: px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[var(--c-muted)]/10 border border-[var(--c-border)]/50 text-xs
exact_tailwind_classes.upgrade_link: civr-btn civr-btn-ghost civr-btn-sm text-xs text-[#818cf8] hover:underline min-h-[44px] flex items-center px-2
exact_tailwind_classes.status_pill_wcag: civr-pill px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300 light:bg-emerald-100 light:text-emerald-900 border border-emerald-500/30 min-h-[28px] inline-flex items-center
